result:
The root cause was the route pattern itself: `routes/web.ts` registered the archive route as `/posts/archive/:date*`, but Hono's router only treats `:name{regex}` (curly-brace form) as a param that can span multiple path segments — `:date*` is parsed as a literal single-segment param whose name is `date*` (asterisk included), not a wildcard. That's why `/posts/archive/2026/08` (two segments) 404'd — no route had that shape — and `/posts/archive/2026` "matched" but populated `ctx.req.param()` with a `date*` key instead of `date`, so `ArchiveParamSchema` saw a missing required field and threw a 422.

Fix: changed the route to `/posts/archive/:date{.+}` (`routes/web.ts:35`), which correctly captures everything after `/archive/` — including slashes — into `params.date`, matching what `PostController.archive()` and `ArchiveParamSchema` already expected. Regenerated the typed manifests (`bunx guren codegen`) so `.guren/routes.gen.ts`/`api-client.gen.ts` reflect the new path, and added a `posts.archive` test suite in `tests/PostController.test.ts` covering zero-padded and non-padded months, whole-year listing, an empty period, and an out-of-range month (422). `bun run typecheck`, `bunx guren check`, and `bun test` all pass.
